subject: health

location.unitTitle: Safety, Injury Prevention, and Digital Life

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the private-safe task without disclosing medical history, diagnosis, body measurements, or sexual history.
Use a fictional scenario when offered and identify a trusted adult or qualified professional where appropriate.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain injury prevention and protective gear in your own words and give or identify a valid example.

Use a diagram of a general figure or character rather than your own body, a picture sequence, a model, a described demonstration, or a checked source, to show what you learned about emergency response and calling for help.
Apply what you learned about medicines, household chemicals, and substance safety to a new fictional situation. Show the steps or name the source you relied on.
A made-up character makes an unsafe or unreliable choice involving basic first aid and when to get an adult. Explain what is wrong, correct it, and say why the correction is safer.
Connect injury prevention and protective gear with recognising unsafe requests and refusing. Explain how the two ideas support or depend on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Create a safety and refusal plan covering an activity, an online situation, and an emergency, reviewed and confirmed by a guardian.
Name one skill you can now use somewhere else, one way to check your own work, and one question you still have. This is about the skill, not about your private life; nothing private has to be shared.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated reasoning and evidence criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. Choosing an adapted or opt-out path is never scored as a deficit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Safety, Injury Prevention, and Digital Life?
